content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint analysis lacks handling of missing data and intercurrent events",
      "quote": "Patients who are not evaluable for BOR will be considered as non-responders.",
      "page": 77,
      "section": "11.4.3.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The primary analysis defines non-evaluable as non-responders but does not specify how missing data (e.g., due to early dropout) or intercurrent events (e.g., treatment discontinuation) are handled in the estimand. The estimand attributes are incomplete.",
      "fix": "Specify the estimand for ORR including handling of missing data and intercurrent events (e.g., treatment discontinuation, death) in the SAP."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary efficacy endpoints lack estimand specification",
      "quote": "The secondary efficacy endpoints as measured by DOR, PFS, and OS will be summarized by median and its 95% confidence interval using the Kaplan-Meier method.",
      "page": 78,
      "section": "11.4.3.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The analysis for DOR, PFS, and OS only states a summary measure (median with CI) but does not define the estimand population, variable definitions (e.g., event definitions, censoring rules), or intercurrent event handling (e.g., treatment switching, non-progression death).",
      "fix": "Define estimands for DOR, PFS, and OS including population, variable definitions, intercurrent event strategies, and summary measures."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exploratory endpoint HPV serotyping has no analysis method",
      "quote": "HPV serotyping of archival tumor",
      "page": 35,
      "section": "4.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The exploratory endpoint 'HPV serotyping of archival tumor' is listed but no statistical analysis method is described in the statistical plan. It is unclear how this endpoint will be analyzed or summarized.",
      "fix": "Add a description of the analysis for HPV serotyping in the statistical plan or SAP."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size justification lacks power and effect size inputs",
      "quote": "The planned total sample size for this study is 105 patients.",
      "page": 76,
      "section": "11.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The sample size justification provides precision-based confidence intervals but does not state the assumed true response rate, power, or effect size. The protocol does not specify a null or target ORR, making it unclear how the sample size was derived.",
      "fix": "Include the assumed response rate and precision target, or state that the sample size is based on feasibility, and provide the rationale."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing data handling not specified for any efficacy endpoint",
      "quote": "Data collected regarding the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the patients will be summarized (eg, discontinuation due to COVID-19).",
      "page": 76,
      "section": "11",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The statistical plan mentions COVID-19 impact but does not provide a general strategy for handling missing data (e.g., for ORR, PFS, OS) or sensitivity analyses. This is a gap in the estimand specification.",
      "fix": "Add a section on missing data handling for all endpoints, including sensitivity analyses."
    },
    {
      "title": "Multiplicity not addressed for secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "The secondary objectives of the study are: • To characterize the safety profile of cemiplimab + ISA101b • To assess preliminary efficacy of cemiplimab + ISA101b as measured by DOR, progression-free survival (PFS), and OS",
      "page": 29,
      "section": "2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not mention any adjustment for multiplicity when testing multiple secondary endpoints (DOR, PFS, OS). Although the study is descriptive, if any formal inference is intended, this is a gap.",
      "fix": "State whether multiplicity adjustment is needed or clarify that secondary endpoints are descriptive only."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistency in analysis set for safety and efficacy",
      "quote": "The full analysis set (FAS) includes all enrolled patients who received any study drug. Efficacy, safety, and baseline variables will be analyzed or summarized using the FAS.",
      "page": 76,
      "section": "11.3.1",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The FAS is used for both efficacy and safety, but safety analyses often use a safety set (all patients who received any study drug). This is consistent, but the protocol does not define a separate safety analysis set, which may be acceptable but should be explicit.",
      "fix": "Clarify that the FAS is the safety set, or define a separate safety analysis set if needed."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exploratory biomarker analysis lacks detail for association methods",
      "quote": "The association of PD-L1 expression in tumor and infiltrating immune cells with clinical efficacy and available data on changes is HPV antigen specific T cell responses in a subset of patients will be included in the CSR.",
      "page": 79,
      "section": "11.4.7",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The analysis for exploratory biomarkers is vague; it does not specify statistical methods (e.g., regression, correlation) or how multiple biomarkers will be handled. This may be acceptable for exploratory analyses but should be detailed in the SAP.",
      "fix": "Specify the statistical methods for biomarker associations in the SAP."
    }
  ]
}
